admits a linear reference, so with --claim-gate tracker-assignee a task linked to a Linear issue is claimed on this install only while Linear shows the issue assigned to this install\\u0027s viewer id; the dispatcher, h9k task drive, h9k task start, and h9k task queue all read it through that one gate. On a project with the gate off, no claim door reads Linear to decide a claim; the mirrors in the criterion below still run.\u0022,\u0022The identity compared is the viewer\\u0027s user id that A records on the Linear connection, compared ordinally, never the name or the email. A Linear connection that carries no id answers Unreadable with the remedy naming h9k connection add linear, and makes no live viewer read. Linear\\u0027s delegate field is neither read nor written.\u0022,\u0022Read failures map as follows, each keeping Linear\\u0027s own words: a rejected key maps to Credentials and the remedy names h9k connection add linear; an HTTP 429 or an error carrying the code RATELIMITED, a 5xx, a timeout, or an unreachable host maps to Outage and waits for the next sweep; every other GraphQL error, which includes an issue that is not found or not visible, maps to Item, and its remedy defers to Linear\\u0027s own words plus the moved-team relink hint A defines, never to the shared sentence that nothing on this install ends the hold. An HTTP 200 carrying an errors array is never read as an assignment.\u0022,\u0022h9k task queue \\u003Cid\\u003E --take and h9k task assign \\u003Cid\\u003E --take on a Linear issue the fresh read shows assigned to nobody write the viewer id through issueUpdate\\u0027s assigneeId, read the issue back, record TrackerAssignmentWritten from that read-back, and proceed; an issue somebody else holds is refused exactly as today with nothing written (piece E changes that refusal); an issue already yours records TrackerAssignmentObserved and proceeds; the write touches no state, label, or other field. A response with success false, or an errors array, is a refused write, and its sentence keeps Linear\\u0027s own words and says the key needs write permission on the issue\\u0027s team.\u0022,\u0022Because Linear\\u0027s assignee is single-valued, the Linear take follows Jira\\u0027s overwrite shape and never GitHub\\u0027s add-assignee shape, so a Contested verdict cannot arise from it, and a test pins the read-back comparison on the user id\u0022,\u0022TrackerAssignmentTake.ReleaseAsync clears a Linear issue\\u0027s assignee only when the fresh read shows this install\\u0027s own viewer id on it, sending assigneeId as an explicit JSON null that a test pins in the request, confirms by read-back, answers Failed when the read-back still shows this install, and answers NothingToDo for an issue held by nobody or by somebody else\u0022,\u0022The claim-time assign mirror (DispatchEngine.MirrorTrackerAssigneeBestEffortAsync) runs for a Linear issue on every project, and the release mirror runs at the sites it runs at today (lease expiry on a project with the gate off, h9k task abandon, and h9k task release), with the existing TaskTrackerAssignMirrorPending and TaskTrackerReleaseMirrorPending rows retrying a write that did not land on the existing backoff. Closeout leaves a Linear issue\\u0027s assignee in place, as it does on every tracker once 8222011c merges, so this card adds no Linear exception to closeout. A lease expiry on a gated project, and a task moved to another node, keep skipping the release as they do for every tracker.\u0022,\u0022Every Jira-else-GitHub site a Linear reference reaches becomes a provider switch with a Linear arm, so a Linear reference never falls into the GitHub branch: TrackerClaimGate.Gates and CheckAsync, TrackerAssignmentTake.TakeAsync, GrantToAsync, and ReleaseAsync, TrackerClaimDecision.Tracker, ClaimRequestEngine\\u0027s tracker name, and ClaimRequestWatchLoop.ApplyDeclaredTrackerIdentity, which leaves a Linear request\\u0027s carried identity in place as it does for Jira. GrantToAsync moves a Linear issue from unassigned or from this install\\u0027s own id to the grantee\\u0027s id for the cooperative take.\u0022,\u0022Every sentence the gate and the take print for a Linear issue names Linear as the tracker, the identifier as the item, and the issue\\u0027s web URL in the assign-yourself lever, and a claim the dispatcher refuses publishes the same TrackerClaimHold reference skill all name a Linear issue alongside a Jira card and a GitHub issue.\u0022,\u0022Every Linear call in these tests runs against recorded responses and no test reaches a live workspace; the
